hens_rule_text: no chickens allowed on lots under 7,000 sq ft; 4 hens allowed on lots from 7,000 to 12,000 sq ft; up to 20 on larger lots; no roosters
permit_notes: Some secondary summaries mention a permit may be required; the city's own poultry handout was not read in full to confirm a permit process.
setback_notes: Coop setbacks range from 25 to 50 ft from property lines depending on lot size (not stated specifically as distance from homes); manure must be stored in sealed containers or composted at least 50 ft from neighboring residences.
coop_rules: Chickens must be enclosed and not allowed to roam loose; manure storage or composting must be kept at least 50 ft from neighboring residences.
zoning_notes: Minimum lot size of 7,000 sq ft applies before any hens are allowed; hen cap scales up with lot size (4 on 7,000 to 12,000 sq ft, 20 on lots over that).
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
